# Zeeshan Sarfraz Portfolio

> Zeeshan Sarfraz is a Full Stack Developer, Software Engineer, and Computer Science (BSCS) student at NUML Lahore. Specializing in React, Flutter, Node.js, and Firebase. Founder / Lead at Zyfiro.

## Core Stack & Skills

- **Frontend**: React, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, TailwindCSS
- **Mobile**: Flutter, Dart, Firebase
- **Backend & Database**: Node.js, Express, Firebase Firestore & Realtime DB, MongoDB
- **Languages**: C++, JavaScript, Dart, SQL

## Featured Projects

- [z-nectar](https://github.com/xeeshan-zs/z-nectar): All-in-one mobile app for student services & utilities.
- [EduSync](https://github.com/xeeshan-zs/EduSync): Smart education platform for assignment & schedule tracking.
- [Library Management System](https://github.com/xeeshan-zs/Library-Management): High-performance C++ OOP management tool.
